Directions (1 – 5): In the following questions the symbols #, *, @. $ and = are used with the following  
meanings:  
A # B means A is greater than B.  
A * B means A is greater than or equal to B.  
A @ B means A is equal to B.  
A $ B means A is lesser than B.  
A = B means A is lesser than or equal to B.  
Now in each of the following questions, assuming the three statements to be true, find which of the two  
conclusions I and II given below them is/are true. Give answer.  
1) If only conclusion I is true  
2) If only conclusion II is true  
3) If either conclusion I or conclusion II is true  
4) If neither conclusion I nor conclusion II is true  
5) If both conclusions I and II are true.  
1. Statements: Q # R, S $ Q, S * P  
Conclusions: I. R # S  
Ans: 4  
II. R $ S  
Decoded statement: Q > R, S < Q, S ≥ P  
Decoded conclusion: I. R ≤ S II. R < S  
Combined Inequalities: P ≤ S < Q > R  
P ≤ S < Q > R  
No relationship can be established between R and S. Hence conclusion I and II  
does not follow.  
2. Statements: A = B, D @ C, C # A  
Conclusions: I. D = B  
Ans: 4  
II. C * D  
Inequality 2  
Decoded statement: A ≤ B, D = C, C > A  
Decoded conclusion: I. D ≤ B  
II. C ≥ D  
Combined Inequalities: D = C > A ≤ B  
D = C > A ≤ B  
No relationship can be established between D and B. Hence conclusion I does not  
follow.  
D = C > A ≤ B  
D = C. Hence conclusion II does not follow.  
3. Statements : Q @ R, M @ N, Q # M  
Conclusions : I. R # N  
Ans: 5  
II. N $ Q  
Decoded statement: Q = R, M = N, Q > M  
Decoded conclusion: I. R > N  
II. N < Q  
Combined Inequalities: N = M < Q = R  
N = M < Q = R  
N = M < Q = R  
R > N. Hence conclusion I follows.  
N < Q. Hence conclusion II follows.  
4. Statements: Q # N # M, M # O @ R, R $ T @ S  
Conclusions : I. S @ N  
Ans: 4  
II. M @ S  
Decoded statement: Q > N > M, M > O = R, R < T = S  
Decoded conclusion: I. S = N II. M = S  
Combined Inequalities: Q > N > M > O = R < T = S  
Q > N > M > O = R < T = S  
does not follow.  
No relationship can be established between S and N. Hence conclusion I  
Q > N > M > O = R < T = S  
II does not follow.  
No relationship can be established between M and S. Hence conclusion  
Inequality 2  
5. Statements : Q * R, R @ U, U * M  
Conclusions : I. R # M  
Ans: 3  
II. M @ R  
Decoded statement: Q ≥ R, R = U, U ≥ M  
Decoded conclusion: I. R > M  
II. M = R  
Combined Inequalities: Q ≥ R = U ≥ M  
Q ≥ R = U ≥ M  
R ≥ M. Hence either conclusion I or II follows.  
Directions (Q. 6-10) In the following questions, the symbols *, +, $, #, δ are used with the following  
meanings.  
A * B means ‘A is not smaller than B’.  
A + B means ‘A is neither greater than nor smaller than B’.  
A $ B means ‘A is not greater than B’.  
A # B means ‘A is neither smaller than nor equal to B’.  
A δ B means ‘A is neither greater than nor equal to B’.  
Now in each of the following questions, assuming the given statements to be true, find which of the two  
conclusions I and II given below them is/are definitely true.  
Give answer  
1) if only conclusion I is true.  
2) if only conclusion II is true.  
3) if either conclusion I or II is true.  
4) if neither conclusion I nor II is true.  
5) if both conclusions I and II are true.  
6). Statements: L * I, F # G, L + G  
Conclusions: I.F # I  
II. I δ G  
Inequality 2  
Ans: 1  
Decoded statement: L ≥ I, F > G, L = G  
Decoded conclusion: I. F > I  
Combined Inequalities: F > G = L ≥ I  
II. I ≥ G  
F > G = L ≥ I  
F > I. Hence conclusion I is true.  
F > G = L ≥ I  
G ≥ I. Hence conclusion II is not true.  
7). Statements: H # R, Z δ Q, Q $ Y, R # Y  
Conclusions: I.R # Q  
Ans: 5  
II.H # Z  
Decoded statement: H > R, Z < Q, Q ≤ Y, R > Y  
Decoded conclusion: I. R > Q  
II. H > Z  
Combined Inequalities: H > R > Y ≥ Q > Z  
H > R > Y ≥ Q > Z  
R > Q. Hence conclusion I is true.  
H > Z. Hence conclusion II is true.  
H > R > Y ≥ Q > Z  
8). Statements: E + Q, N * E, Q * X  
Conclusions: I.N + X  
Ans: 3  
II.N # X  
Decoded statement: E = Q, N ≥ E, Q ≥ X  
Decoded conclusion: I. N = X  
II. N > X  
Combined Inequalities: N ≥ E = Q ≥ X  
N ≥ E = Q ≥ X  
N ≥ E. Hence either conclusion I or II is true.  
9). Statements: K * V, B $ W, W * K  
Inequality 2  
Conclusions: I.B + K  
Ans: 4  
II.W + V  
Decoded statement: K ≥ V, B ≤ W, W ≥ K  
Decoded conclusion: I. B = K  
II. W = V  
Combined Inequalities: B ≤ W ≥ K ≥ V  
B ≤ W ≥ K ≥ V  
No relationship cam be established between B and K. Hence conclusion I is not  
true.  
B ≤ W ≥ K ≥ V  
No relationship cam be established between W and V. Hence conclusion II is not  
true.  
10). Statements: P # Q, R + P, Q $ M  
Conclusions: I.R # M  
II.Q + M  
Ans: 4  
Decoded statement: P > Q, R = P, Q ≤ M  
Decoded conclusion: I. R > M  
Combined Inequalities: R = P > Q ≤ M  
II. Q = M  
R = P > Q ≤ M  
No relationship can be established between R and M. Hence conclusion I is not true.  
R = P > Q ≤ M  
Q ≤ M. Hence conclusion II is not true.
